name: p_13_1_rectangle_area
nat_lang_statement: Given a class Rectangle with instance variables width and height, provide a recursive getArea method. Construct a rectangle whose width is one less than the original and call its getArea method.

dafny.method_signature: p_13_1_rectangle_area(width: nat, height: nat) returns (area: nat)
dafny.functional_code:
function rect_area(width: nat, height: nat) : nat
  ensures rect_area(width, height) == width * height
{
  match (width, height)
  case (0, _) => 0
  case (_, 0) => 0
  case (_, _) => rect_area(width - 1, height) + height
}

name: p_13_2_square_area_method
nat_lang_statement: Given a class Square with instance variable width, provide a recursive getArea method. Construct a square whose width is one less than the original and call its getArea method.

dafny.functional_code:
function square_area(width: nat) : nat
  ensures square_area(width) == width * width
{
  match width
  case 0 => 0
  case _ => square_area(width - 1) + 2 * width - 1
}

name: p_13_3_reverse_string_method
nat_lang_statement: Write a recursive method String reverse(String text) that reverses a string. For example, reverse("Hello!") returns the string "!olleH". Implement a recursive solution by removing the first character, reversing the remaining text, and combining the two.

ensures: forall i :: 0 <= i < |text| ==> reversed[i] == text[|text| - 1 - i]

name: p_13_5_reverse_string_iterative
nat_lang_statement: Implement the reverse method of Exercise P13.3 as an iteration.

ensures: forall i :: 0 <= i < |text| ==> reversed[i] == text[|text| - 1 - i]

name: p_13_6_find_string
nat_lang_statement: Use recursion to implement a method public static boolean find(String text, String str) that tests whether a given text contains a string. For example, find("Mississippi", "sip") returns true. If the text starts with the string you want to match, then you are done. If not, consider the text that you obtain by removing the first character.

dafny.method_signature: p_13_6_find_string(text: string, str: string) returns (found: bool)
ensures: found == (exists i :: 0 <= i <= |text| - |str| && starts_with(text[i..], str) == true)

name: p_13_7_index_of_string
nat_lang_statement: Use recursion to implement a method public static int indexOf(String text, String str) that returns the starting position of the first substring of the text that matches str. Return -1 if str is not a substring of the text. For example, s.indexOf("Mississippi", "sip") returns 6. Keep track of how far the match is from the beginning of the text using a helper method parameter.

dafny.method_signature: p_13_7_index_of_string(text: string, str: string) returns (index: int)
